_doc: Retail-side field spec for the execution+dataflow trace (docs/plans/execution-flow-trace.md). Maps each instrumented engine VA -> the declared payload the Frida agent reads at that call, joined to the port's CALL_TRACE_* fields by (va, field-name). VA keys + global VAs accept 0x-hex or decimal. src: global (read DAT at va) | arg (stack param index, 1-based) | argderef (deref arg[index] + off) | retval (onLeave). type: i32|u32|f32|hex.
